name: Why Puget Sound Humidity Changes Your Everett Refinishing Schedule
title-tag: Humidity and Refinishing Schedules in Everett, WA
meta-description: Puget Sound damp doesn't stop a refinish — it stretches the clock. What humidity does to wood, finish, and your 3–5 day Everett schedule, and when to wait.
post-summary: February 22, 2027 · Wet-season refinishing works fine in a heated Everett house — humidity stretches the coating schedule rather than stopping the job. What damp air does to wood, to finish drying, and to your 3–5 day timeline, why a cupped floor is the one real reason to postpone, and how we condition a house instead of waiting for the forecast.
